display.purpose: Shared responsive display role; restored homepage uses home-display.

home-display.purpose: Restored homepage hero; self-hosted Nunito 800, 2rem below 640px and 1.8rem below 380px.

home-story-emphasis.purpose: Georgia italic emphasis within product stories.

motion.name: product-transition
motion.purpose: Product hover; disabled for reduced motion.

motion.name: home-hero-slide
motion.purpose: Horizontal background slide every 4500ms; pauses on hover/focus, manual pause and reduced motion.

motion.name: dock-magnification
motion.value: distance [-150,0,150]; item [40,80,40]px; icon [20,40,20]px; spring mass 0.1, stiffness 150, damping 12

motion.name: dock-mobile-stack
motion.value: 0.05s stagger; reversed entry order; opacity and 10px y displacement

motion.name: dock-reduced-motion
motion.value: fixed item/icon 40/20px; no displacement or stagger; tooltip/mobile duration 0

documentationSource.note: Synchronized with shared Aceternity primary navigation; existing shared and homepage tokens preserved.

homepageVariation.layout: 1280px source container; 1240px stories. Hero width 90%, radius 32px, desktop minimum height 600px. Below 640px: 24px radius, 260px photograph above copy. Stories stack below 700px; booking stacks below 768px. Shared dock navigation follows its own 768px breakpoint.
homepageVariation.materials: Nunito 500/800 hero, Be Vietnam Pro body, Georgia story italics; local pet photographs.
homepageVariation.components: Orange/red Flash Sale gradient with green badges and price ribbons; brown closing banner and warm footer with square upper corners.
homepageVariation.authority: Shared root tokens continue to govern other routes.

sharedNavigation.ownership: One shared layout instance on every route; supersedes header primary links/mobile navigation drawer and homepage-only dock. Header brand/search/language/account/cart actions remain.
sharedNavigation.desktop: At least 768px: fixed bottom-center, 24px bottom offset, z-40; 64px tray, 16px radius/gaps/horizontal padding, 12px bottom padding; 40→80px circles, 20→40px icons.
sharedNavigation.mobile: Below 768px: fixed right/bottom 20px, z-40; 40px circles, 16px destination icons, 20px toggle icon, vertical stack with 8px gaps.
sharedNavigation.accessibility: Localized icon names, aria-current page, hover/focus tooltip, expanded/control state and Escape focus return. Source 40px targets explicitly chosen by user.
sharedNavigation.authority: Pinned source utilities and Motion own styling; no replacement custom CSS or legacy home-dock palette. Tailwind v4 utilities omit global preflight.
sharedNavigation.dark: Ancestor .dark enables original neutral-900/800 surfaces, neutral-300/400 icons and white tooltip text; no added site theme switch.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Shared action control; hero action groups use pill corners.
components.css: .ds-primary{font-family:var(--font, Be Vietnam Pro, system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, sans-serif);display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;min-height:46px;padding:12px 22px;border:1px solid var(--c-line,#EBE5DF);border-radius:var(--radius-sm,10px);background:var(--c-blue,#326DCA);color:white;border-color:var(--c-blue,#326DCA);font-size:.9rem;font-weight:600;line-height:1.4;cursor:pointer;transition:background-color .18s,color .18s,border-color .18s;}.ds-primary:hover{background:var(--c-blue-dark,#2757A8);box-shadow:0 3px 8px rgba(50,109,202,.15);}.ds-primary:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--c-blue,#326DCA);outline-offset:2px;}

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Shared action control; hero action groups use pill corners.
components.css: .ds-secondary{font-family:var(--font, Be Vietnam Pro, system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, sans-serif);display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;min-height:46px;padding:12px 22px;border:1px solid var(--c-line,#EBE5DF);border-radius:var(--radius-sm,10px);background:white;color:var(--c-ink,#201A16);font-size:.9rem;font-weight:600;line-height:1.4;cursor:pointer;transition:background-color .18s,color .18s,border-color .18s;}.ds-secondary:hover{background:var(--stitch-blue-soft,#E8F0FE);color:var(--c-blue,#326DCA);border-color:var(--c-blue,#326DCA);box-shadow:0 3px 8px rgba(50,109,202,.15);}.ds-secondary:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--c-blue,#326DCA);outline-offset:2px;}

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Labeled shared field with an invalid-state border.
components.html: <label class="ds-field">Họ và tên<input placeholder="Tên của bạn" /></label>
components.css: .ds-field{font-family:var(--font, Be Vietnam Pro, system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, sans-serif);display:grid;gap:8px;color:var(--c-ink,#201A16);font-size:.8rem;}.ds-field input{font:inherit;font-size:1rem;min-width:0;min-height:48px;padding:11px 14px;border:1px solid var(--c-line,#EBE5DF);border-radius:8px;background:white;color:var(--c-ink,#201A16);line-height:1.5;}.ds-field input:hover{border-color:#b8a99d;}.ds-field input[aria-invalid=true]{border-color:var(--c-danger,#B3261E);}.ds-field input:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--c-blue,#326DCA);outline-offset:2px;}

components.name: Category Chip
components.css: .ds-chip{font-family:var(--font, Be Vietnam Pro, system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, sans-serif);min-height:44px;padding:10px 16px;border:1px solid var(--c-line,#EBE5DF);border-radius:999px;background:white;color:var(--c-ink,#201A16);font-size:.8rem;cursor:pointer;}.ds-chip[aria-pressed=true]{background:var(--c-blue,#326DCA);border-color:var(--c-blue,#326DCA);color:white;}.ds-chip:hover{text-decoration:underline;}.ds-chip:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--c-blue,#326DCA);outline-offset:2px;}

components.name: Shared Floating Dock
components.description: Primary navigation on every route. Static desktop source specimen; runtime TSX supplies spring magnification, mobile stack and reduced motion.
components.css: .ds-dock{display:flex;align-items:flex-end;gap:16px;height:64px;box-sizing:border-box;padding:0 16px 12px;border-radius:16px;background:oklch(98.5% 0.002 247.839)}.ds-dock a{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;width:40px;height:40px;border-radius:9999px;background:oklch(92.8% 0.006 264.531);color:oklch(55.6% 0 none);text-decoration:none}.ds-dock svg{width:20px;height:20px}.ds-dock a:focus-visible{outline:auto}.ds-dock a:hover{cursor:pointer}.dark .ds-dock{background:oklch(20.5% 0 none)}.dark .ds-dock a{background:oklch(26.9% 0 none);color:oklch(87% 0 none)}

narrative.northStar: The selected Stitch pet shop templates
narrative.overview: The selected Stitch page templates establish warm pet photography, brown identity details, blue actions and rounded white surfaces. The same language continues through service pages, booking, accounts, shopping and reading pages; operational screens use tighter spacing and visible borders. The / homepage follows the pinned local code-animated.html variation within .demo-home and .home-reference; shared tokens continue to govern other routes. One shared user-pinned Aceternity Floating Dock supplies primary navigation across every route; header utility actions remain.
keyCharacteristics: Warm cream beside pale gray and white surfaces.
Blue controls and prices; brown identity and care accents.
Self-hosted Vietnamese typography and natural pet/shop imagery.
dos: Do follow the exported Stitch pages and implemented tokens; preserve the pinned local HTML variation and scoped source styles for /.
Do preserve visible focus, validation, empty states and bilingual text wrapping.
Do retain illustration/demo labels where the application shows them.
Do preserve one shared source Floating Dock on every route, with explicitly chosen 40px targets, exact neutral utilities, dark variants and reduced-motion behavior.
donts: Don’t substitute the unrelated coral project metadata for the page palette.
Don’t assume every button is a pill: form and card controls use smaller corners.
Don’t introduce remote fonts or remove reduced-motion behavior.
